title: Tall Whites mistaken for ancient Egyptians at Indian Springs
summary: Charles Hall tells of Tall Whites mistaken for ancient Egyptians at Indian Springs, about 1960s at Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Rangemen took the tall whites for ancient Egyptians because of their hieroglyphic writing

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he worked on the Indian Springs ranges in the Nevada desert in the 1960s alongside tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites, says not everyone there knew what they were. He has told podcast host Jesse Michels, on two shows in 2025, that a couple of the men working with him who had seen them thought they were ancient Egyptians who had somehow got into the valley, been trapped there, and still wrote in their own hieroglyphics. In his telling, it shows how strange and old-fashioned the beings and their writing seemed to people who came across them.
